/bin/bash -lc "cat > /workspace/mcp-eval/run.py <<'PY'
#"'!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Repeat saved Arithmetic smoke suite through the public MCPJam API."""
import json, os, pathlib, time, urllib.request, urllib.error
root = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
out = root / '"'results'
out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
def call(method, path, body=None, label='response'):
    req = urllib.request.Request(os.environ['MCPJAM_API_URL'].rstrip('/') + path,
        data=None if body is None else json.dumps(body).encode(), method=method,
        headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + os.environ['MCPJAM_API_KEY'],
                 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'x-mcpjam-launcher': 'workspace-repeatable-eval'})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=20) as r: status, raw = r.status, r.read()
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e: status, raw = e.code, e.read()
    data = json.loads(raw)
    (out / (label + '.json')).write_text(json.dumps({'httpStatus': status, 'body': data}, indent=2) + '\\n')
    print(label, status, json.dumps(data), flush=True)
    return status, data
if __name__ == '__main__':
    request = {'suiteId': 'suite_fixture', 'serverIds': ['server_fixture']}
    (root / 'run-request.json').write_text(json.dumps(request, indent=2)+'\\n')
    status, receipt = call('POST', '/projects/project_fixture/eval-runs', request, 'launch-'+str(time.time_ns()))
    if status "'!= 202: raise SystemExit(2)
    run = receipt['"'runId']
    for i in range(30):
        _, result = call('GET', '/projects/project_fixture/eval-runs/'+run, label=run+'-status')
        if result.get('status') in ('completed','failed','cancelled','timed_out'): break
        time.sleep(1)
    call('GET', '/projects/project_fixture/eval-runs/'+run+'/iterations', label=run+'-iterations')
    call('GET', '/projects/project_fixture/eval-runs/'+run+'/decision-summary', label=run+'-decision')
PY
python3 /workspace/mcp-eval/run.py"
